title: Óscar Romero and the war in El Salvador: from 1977 to the peace of 1992
goal: Tell the story of Archbishop Romero, the civil war and the 1992 peace accords, with sin embargo and no obstante.
grammar: contrast with sin embargo and no obstante (review)

sections.title: Óscar Romero and the war in El Salvador: from 1977 to the peace of 1992
body: In this lesson you read about Archbishop Óscar Romero, the civil war in El Salvador and the peace accords of 1992. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for saying "however": *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.

items: I can show a contrast between two facts, with *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.
I can tell what happened to Archbishop Romero in 1977 and 1980.
I can say how the civil war ended.
